Summary: Repository, branching strategy and project board
Description: As the team, we want a shared repo, branch rules and a board so that work is visible and reviewed.
Acceptance Criteria: Repo with master + feature branches | Board columns Backlog / To Do / In Progress / Review / Done | Collaborators added

Summary: SRS with MoSCoW prioritisation
Description: As the team, we want agreed functional and non-functional requirements so that we build the right scope.
Acceptance Criteria: 60 FRs and 29 NFRs written | Must / Should / May marked | Reviewed by all members

Summary: Streamlit prototype of profile → gap → path
Description: As a student, I want an early working prototype so that the team can validate the recommendation flow.
Acceptance Criteria: Login, profile, resume upload, gap chart, learning path | 21 automated tests passing | Kept in prototype/streamlit-mvp

Summary: Skill taxonomy and seed datasets
Description: As the AI engine, I need a skill taxonomy, role requirements and a resource catalogue so that gaps and recommendations can be computed.
Acceptance Criteria: 33 skills with synonyms and categories | 9 roles, 67 role-skill weights | 76 resources, 37 projects, 17 certifications, 99 quiz questions

Summary: Design system and screen inventory
Description: As a student, I want a consistent, responsive UI so that the app is easy to use on any device.
Acceptance Criteria: Colour, type and spacing tokens | Reusable buttons, cards, inputs, dialogs | Screen inventory agreed

Summary: Landing and public pages
Description: As a visitor, I want to understand the product before signing up.
Acceptance Criteria: Landing, features, how it works, about, contact pages | Responsive at 360 px

Summary: Auth screens: sign up, login, verify, forgot / reset password
Description: As a student, I want to create an account and recover it so that my data stays mine.
Acceptance Criteria: Client validation with inline errors | Password strength meter | Verify-email and reset flows wired to the API

Summary: ER diagram and database schema
Description: As the backend, we need a normalised schema so that profiles, paths and progress are stored reliably.
Acceptance Criteria: ER diagram for 21 tables | SQLAlchemy models with FKs and cascades | Alembic migration 0001 runs on PostgreSQL and SQLite

Summary: Register and login API with JWT
Description: As a student, I want to register and log in securely.
Acceptance Criteria: bcrypt hashes | JWT bearer tokens | 409 on duplicate email, 401 on wrong password, 403 until verified

Summary: Email verification and password reset API
Description: As a student, I want to verify my email and reset a forgotten password.
Acceptance Criteria: Single-use hashed tokens with expiry | Forgot-password never reveals whether an email exists | Demo mode when SMTP is not configured

Summary: Test plan and test case design
Description: As the team, we want a test plan so that every requirement has a test.
Acceptance Criteria: Scope, strategy, environments, entry / exit criteria | Test cases traced to FRs / NFRs

Summary: Profile API: details, skills, courses, projects
Description: As a student, I want to save my education, skills, courses and projects so that recommendations fit me.
Acceptance Criteria: GET / PUT / DELETE /profile | Skill levels 0–5 | Courses and projects add inferred skills | Validation errors are field-specific

Summary: Skill extraction from courses, projects and text
Description: As a student, I want skills detected from what I've done so that I don't have to type everything.
Acceptance Criteria: Synonym dictionary matching | Course → level 2, project → level 3 | Unit tests

Summary: Gap scoring, severity and importance ranking
Description: As a student, I want a prioritised skill-gap report so that I know what to learn first.
Acceptance Criteria: gap = weight × shortfall; High / Medium / Low | Readiness % | Importance includes prerequisite unlocks

Summary: Skill-gap and career-readiness endpoints
Description: As a student, I want to see my readiness for my goal and for every role.
Acceptance Criteria: POST /analyze/skills | GET /analyze/careers | Updates when the profile changes

Summary: Learning path generation with prerequisites and weekly schedule
Description: As a student, I want a sequenced roadmap that fits my weekly hours so that I can plan my study.
Acceptance Criteria: Topological order | Week numbers and due dates from hours/week | A reason for every module | Re-generation replaces the old path

Summary: Resource ranking and recommendation
Description: As a student, I want the best 3 resources per skill at my level, preferring free ones.
Acceptance Criteria: Weighted score with level, rating, free, type, brevity | Disliked items penalised | Explanation sentence

Summary: Project and certification recommendation
Description: As a student, I want a hands-on project per skill and certifications that match my readiness.
Acceptance Criteria: One project per module by difficulty | Certification level follows readiness | Cost, provider, prep time shown

Summary: Store learning paths and recommendations
Description: As a student, I want my roadmap saved so that I can continue later.
Acceptance Criteria: learning_paths, path_modules, recommendations tables | GET /recommendations returns the active path | Bookmark (save) items

Summary: Catalogue API with search, filters and admin CRUD
Description: As a student, I want to browse resources; as an admin, I want to curate them.
Acceptance Criteria: Filter by skill, type, level, free, text; sort; paginate | Admin-only create / update / delete | Cache invalidated on edit

Summary: Skill quizzes with adaptive path updates
Description: As a student, I want to prove a skill with a quiz so that the roadmap adapts.
Acceptance Criteria: ≥ 80% completes the module | < 50% adds easier material and time | Scores stored

Summary: Feedback-based resource replacement
Description: As a student, I want to mark a resource too easy, too hard or not relevant so that it is replaced.
Acceptance Criteria: Replacement one level up / down | Not relevant removes it | Logged in adaptation_log

Summary: Progress tracking and analytics API
Description: As a student, I want to see completion, study time, streaks and quiz history.
Acceptance Criteria: Item and module status | Study minutes logged | Overall %, streak, daily / weekly hours, readiness history

Summary: Notifications and achievements API
Description: As a student, I want nudges and badges so that I stay motivated.
Acceptance Criteria: Adaptation events as notifications | Inactivity nudge after 7 days | 10 badges with progress

Summary: Admin statistics and user management API
Description: As an admin, I want platform metrics and the ability to disable accounts.
Acceptance Criteria: /admin/stats, /admin/users, /admin/feedback | Admin role required

Summary: Onboarding wizard and profile pages
Description: As a first-time student, I want guided onboarding so that my profile is complete.
Acceptance Criteria: 7-step onboarding | Profile view and edit with unsaved-changes warning

Summary: Dashboard, skill-gap and career pages
Description: As a student, I want a dashboard with my path, progress and upcoming tasks.
Acceptance Criteria: Stat cards and charts | Radar / bar chart of skills vs role | Career explorer with readiness

Summary: Roadmap page with quiz and feedback
Description: As a student, I want to follow my roadmap, take quizzes and give feedback in one place.
Acceptance Criteria: Timeline of modules with reasons | Quiz modal | Feedback buttons | Regenerate with confirmation

Summary: Resources, projects, certifications and wishlist pages
Description: As a student, I want to browse and bookmark learning content.
Acceptance Criteria: Filters and search | Bookmarks in wishlist | Empty and error states

Summary: Analytics, notifications, achievements, settings and support pages
Description: As a student, I want to see my analytics and manage my account.
Acceptance Criteria: Charts of hours and quiz scores | Mark notifications read | Change password, export data, delete account

Summary: Rate limiting, data export and account deletion
Description: As a student, I want my account protected and my data portable.
Acceptance Criteria: 429 after 20 auth attempts / min / IP | GET /profile/export JSON | DELETE /profile cascades

Summary: Automated unit and API tests (pytest)
Description: As the team, we want automated tests so that regressions are caught in every PR.
Acceptance Criteria: ≥ 85% coverage gate | Runs on PostgreSQL in CI | Security cases: auth, IDOR, SQL injection

Summary: Postman collection and Newman in CI
Description: As the team, we want API contract tests runnable by anyone.
Acceptance Criteria: 37 requests with assertions | Newman job in GitHub Actions | JUnit report artefact

Summary: Recommendation accuracy test with sample profiles
Description: As the team, we want to measure recommendation quality, not just correctness.
Acceptance Criteria: 8 labelled profiles | Precision@3 ≥ 0.85, prerequisite order 100%, level fit ≥ 0.85

Summary: Frontend–backend integration and browser E2E test
Description: As the team, we want the full flow tested in a browser.
Acceptance Criteria: Sign-up → verify → onboarding → roadmap → quiz → analytics | No console errors

Summary: Docker, Render and Vercel deployment
Description: As a user, I want the app online.
Acceptance Criteria: Dockerfiles and docker-compose | render.yaml blueprint | vercel.json SPA rewrites | Live URLs recorded in README

Summary: CI/CD pipeline and PR automation
Description: As the team, we want every PR checked and labelled automatically.
Acceptance Criteria: Lint, tests, migrations, Newman, frontend build | Auto label and assign PRs | CODEOWNERS reviewers

Summary: Architecture, database, API and deployment documentation
Description: As a future developer, I want documentation so that I can run and extend the system.
Acceptance Criteria: SW architecture, ER diagram + data dictionary, API reference | Deviations documented

Summary: Sprint 2 review, retrospective and demo video
Description: As the team, we want to reflect and present the product.
Acceptance Criteria: Retro notes in docs/retros | Demo video recorded

Summary: OAuth sign-in (Google, GitHub, LinkedIn)
Description: As a student, I want to sign in with an existing account.
Acceptance Criteria: OAuth 2.0 flows | Account linking

Summary: Educator dashboard with at-risk students
Description: As an educator, I want to see class progress and students at risk.
Acceptance Criteria: Educator role | Risk flag from ai_engine.adaptive.risk_flag

Summary: Downloadable PDF progress report and portfolio
Description: As a student, I want a PDF of my skills, projects and certifications.
Acceptance Criteria: PDF export | Shareable link

Summary: Email reminders for study sessions
Description: As a student, I want reminder emails for upcoming deadlines.
Acceptance Criteria: Scheduled job | Opt-out

Summary: Learned ranker from feedback data
Description: As a student, I want recommendations that improve from everyone's feedback.
Acceptance Criteria: Train on feedback table | A/B against rule-based ranking
